added.title: Vice President, Product & Innovation Execution Team
added.description:
Job Description

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President to join our Product and Innovation team. This role is located in New York, NY.

The Vice President on the Product and Innovation Execution Team will provide senior leadership and execution and product development support for complex, high ‑ priority enterprise initiatives spanning capability builds, strategic partnerships, and client activations. This role is accountable for translating strategic priorities into disciplined execution, driving alignment across senior stakeholders, and ensuring initiatives progress in a controlled, enterprise ‑ ready manner.

This individual serves as a trusted partner to leadership, exercising strong judgment and proactively managing risk, interdependencies, and outcomes across products, platforms, and functions.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

Supporting execution for complex, cross ‑ functional initiatives with enterprise impact, driving accountability for outcomes from initiation through launch.
Partnering with senior leaders to shape product development, execution strategy, assess trade ‑ offs, and support informed decision ‑ making.
Driving alignment across key stakeholders such as Product, Engineering, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and external partners, proactively resolving interdependencies and removing barriers.
Embedding enterprise governance, controls, and operational readiness into execution, while identifying, escalating, and resolving material risks and issues.
Standardizing execution approaches and reporting to enable consistent, transparent execution across initiatives.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

5-9 years of experience in senior roles with respect to large-scale initiatives or enterprise programs in financial services, consulting or similarly regulated environments.
A proven track record of informing, educating and influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment without direct authority.
Familiarity with digital assets and blockchain technologies is a strong plus.
Strong executive presence, judgment, and ability to synthesize complexity into clear communications and recommendations.
Excellent oral and written communications skills, with strong attention to detail.
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in high ‑ pressure, evolving environments.
Strong accountability mindset and focus on delivering results at scale.

About Us

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

About The Team

At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at BNY Newsroom & BNY LinkedIn

Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards

America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025
World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025
“Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025

Our Benefits And Rewards

BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer - Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.

BNY assesses market data to ensure a competitive compensation package for our employees. The expected base salary for this position when employment commences can be found in the Job Info section at the bottom of the posting.

Base salary offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Base salary is only part of the total rewards package, which may include eligibility for an annual discretionary incentive award. Subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans then in effect, eligible employees may enroll in a 401(k) plan as well as participate in Company-sponsored medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance plans for the employee and the employee’s eligible dependents. Eligible employees also may receive other benefits (including various paid time off benefits, such as vacation and sick time), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, the employee will be in an “at will” position and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payments or compensation programs) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

added.title: Senior Product Operations Manager, Integrations
added.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As a Product Operations Manager, Integrations at Harvey, you'll own the operating system behind our integrations and partner ecosystem — the APIs, MCP servers, and third-party connectors that let law firms and in-house legal teams plug Harvey into the rest of their tech stack. You'll triage and prioritize integration requests, manage the technology and ISV partners building on our platform, run early-access programs for new integrations, and coordinate the launches that bring them to market — all while building the lightweight systems that let the integrations program scale as our partner ecosystem grows.

This is a role for someone who's spent real time inside an integrations team or a marketplace/app store business, understands what makes an API- or MCP-based integration actually hold up in production, and knows how to balance partner needs against Harvey's own roadmap and security bar.

What You'll Do

Partner & Integration Request Intake
— Making sure the right signal reaches the right team, fast

Own the intake, triage, and prioritization of integration and API/MCP feature requests from customers and partners.
Triage partner- and customer-reported integration issues, assess severity and impact, coordinate resolution across the appropriate teams, and ensure timely communication.
Manage relationships with technology and ISV partners across the integration lifecycle — onboarding, ongoing operations, issue resolution, and delivery quality.

Programs & Launches
— Getting new integrations into partners' and customers' hands, then out the door broadly

Plan and run early-access programs for new integrations and API/MCP capabilities, including partner selection, onboarding, feedback collection, usage analysis, and launch recommendations.
Coordinate cross-functional launches of new integrations by tracking dependencies, validating operational readiness, surfacing risks, and keeping high-priority initiatives on track.

Systems That Scale
— Turning feedback and recurring friction into durable process

Translate partner, customer, and internal feedback into clear requirements, prioritized workstreams, and actionable recommendations for the integrations roadmap.
Create and maintain documentation, playbooks, and enablement materials — including partner-facing API/MCP documentation — that help internal teams and partners communicate and operate effectively.
Identify recurring operational challenges in the partner and integration lifecycle, and implement lightweight systems, automation, and processes (partner onboarding checklists, certification criteria, listing standards) that let the program scale.

What You Have

3-5+ years in Product Operations, Program Management, Partner or Ecosystem Operations, or a related role at a high-growth tech or SaaS company — ideally on a team responsible for integrations, APIs, or a partner platform.
Direct experience working on an integrations team — you've sat inside the function that builds, ships, and supports third-party connections, not just consumed them.
Working knowledge of APIs and MCP (Model Context Protocol) — comfortable in conversations about auth, rate limits, schemas, and what separates a reliable integration from a fragile one.
Experience from an app store, marketplace, or partner ecosystem business — managing listings, partner certification, marketplace policies, or developer relations — so you understand both sides of a two-sided platform.
Experience managing external technology or ISV partner relationships, including onboarding and ongoing delivery quality.
Hands-on experience running early-access or beta programs and coordinating launches in a fast-moving product environment.
Strong written communication — you can turn partner and customer feedback into clear requirements, playbooks, and documentation that both internal and partner teams actually use.
Proven ability to drive cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, Partner/BD and GTM without direct authority.
A bias toward lightweight systems over heavy processes — you'd rather ship a simple fix that scales than a perfect framework nobody uses.

Compensation

$155,400 - $233,200 USD

added.title: Senior Product Manager
added.description:
Link Logistics Real Estate (“Link”) is a leading operator of warehouses and business parks, specializing in last-mile logistics real estate. Established by Blackstone in 2019, the company connects consumption, technology, and the supply chain across its portfolio, which spans half a billion square feet. We leverage our scale, proprietary data and insights, and foundational focus on sustainability to drive success for our customers’ businesses and deliver value for our stakeholders. We put our people, customers, and communities first and find ways to make a conscious, positive impact where we live and work. Every day, we work to reinvent and lead our industry forward by thinking bigger and challenging the status quo.

As the Senior Product Manager
for our Integrated Services team, you will play a pivotal role in defining and executing our technology strategy and roadmap for our business partners responsible for centralized services that manage and maintain our properties. Reporting to the Director of Product, you will be responsible for building and maintaining strong partnerships between the Technology department and business stakeholders. This role requires a strategic thinker with excellent communication skills, a deep understanding of business processes, and the ability to translate business needs into IT solutions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Product Management

Manage the product strategy and roadmap, in partnership with business partners and vendors.
Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of business partners’ processes and operational needs.
Engage with business partners and other stakeholders to create and manage a demand management process to analyze, prioritize, and deliver on project and enhancement requests.
Define and manage OKRs and KPIs that build confidence in the platform and ensure the platform meets the needs and goals of the business.
Engage user communities in a continuous feedback loop that drives the platform forward.

Stakeholder Management

Develop and nurture relationships with key business stakeholders to understand their objectives, challenges, and strategic priorities.
Act as a trusted advisor, providing insights and recommendations on how technology can support and enhance business goals.
Communicate and collaborate across many levels in the organization with excellent and written communication skills.
Translate innovative ideas into functional and technical requirements to helping our teams work smarter.
Guide, influence, and persuade business partners and team members towards solutions that meet business needs and goals.
Maintain relationships with external partners and vendors that challenge them to deliver world-class service for Link.

Project Delivery

Develop business cases, user requirements, and project charters.
Manage processes to prioritize projects, plan releases, and manage resources.
Create and manage processes for testing, release management, and change control.
Manage communications with business partners, project team, and IT management.

Technology Operations

Define and manage data integrations with internal and external products and platforms.
Develop and manage metrics that ensure vendors and external partners meet or exceed operational expectations.
Collaborate with Internal Audit to ensure that IT General Controls are defined as needed for projects and applications and then followed as routine operations.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum of 10 years technology experience
Knowledge of Salesforce, Yardi, or similar applications a plus.
5 years managing customer success, technology operations, or SaaS platform delivery
Expertise in technology product management
Experience defining and managing product roadmaps
Relationship management and customer engagement skills
Technology project management experience
Ability to concisely articulate problems and analyze solution alternatives
Outstanding communication skills
Knowledge of real estate industry and CRE technology a major plus

$165,000 - $180,000 represents the presently anticipated base compensation pay range for this position at Link. Actual pay may vary based on various factors, including but not limited to location and experience.

Link provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, retirement savings plan, paid holidays, paid time off.

The direct compensation and benefits described above are subject to the terms and conditions of any governing plans, policies, practices, agreements, or other materials or documents as in effect from time to time, including but not limited to terms and conditions regarding eligibility.

added.description:
Overview

Build the Future

At McGraw Hill, we are dedicated to delivering digital learning experiences that transform education for learners and educators. Our focus is on creating seamless, impactful products that truly benefit our users while supporting growth and collaboration across teams. We foster a culture that values innovation, teamwork, and a balance between career growth and personal well-being.

How can you make an impact?

The Senior Technical Product Manager leads cross‑functional engineering teams within the Enterprise domain, driving Business Unit (BU) partnership, development, and delivery of scalable, intelligent solutions that power our global digital ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of artificial intelligence, education, and enterprise platform architecture, helping scale AI capabilities that personalize learning, improve outcomes, and drive data‑informed decision making throughout the organization. Success requires a deep technical understanding of AI systems, APIs, databases, and infrastructure, paired with strong product leadership, problem‑solving, and stakeholder management skills.

This is a remote position open to applicants authorized to work for any employer within the United States.

What You'll Do:

Own the product lifecycle within the enterprise team - from planning through execution and continuous optimization - working closely with software engineering, data science, and business leadership to deliver secure, efficient, and integrated solutions.
Lead solution design and architecture discussions, partnering with technical teams to develop scalable, high‑impact enterprise and AI capabilities.
Align and triage with engineering development, testing, and deployment.
Own prioritization and scope alignment for delivery execution, balancing stakeholder needs, business value, and technical feasibility for optimal outcomes.
Define and track key product success metrics, using data and feedback to refine strategy and improve performance across platforms.
Build trusted relationships across enterprise, business, and customer‑facing teams to ensure technology investments translate into measurable impact.
Collaborate with engineering, program management, and leadership teams to define product plans, manage resources, and coordinate successful execution.
Build and disseminate domain expertise to manage dependencies and drive impactful data‑driven solutions.
May have direct reports, and as such hires, trains, develops, and motivates a team of employees. Works with employees to establish annual goals and objectives. Conducts timely performance evaluations. Monitors and controls team expenses.

What You Bring:

5+ years of experience in highly technical product management or related roles (e.g., software engineering, solutions architecture, etc.).
Strong technical acumen, enabling effective partnership with engineering and data science teams and clear communication of complex concepts to non‑technical audiences.
Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, databases, and application infrastructure, with ability to perform initial log reviews and triage issues (coding not required).
Understanding and experience with AI and data infrastructure, including data pipelines, model training workflows, and deployment tools.
Proven ability to build trusted relationships and influence across all organizational levels and diverse, cross‑functional teams.
Exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
Skilled in defining, tracking, and interpreting key performance metrics for AI models and products (e.g., accuracy, precision, ROI).
Demonstrated proactive, metrics‑driven product management leadership that balances business and technical success.
Committed to ethical and responsible AI practices, including bias mitigation, data privacy, and transparency.

Preferred:

2+ years of software engineering experience, preferably in AI space
3+ years of people management or team leadership
Experience with WCAG-compliant design and testing.
Familiarity with UX wire framing and prototyping tools.
Background in EdTech and knowledge of industry-specific challenges.

Why work for us?

The work you do at McGraw Hill will be work that matters. We are collectively building experiences that will help shape the future of education. Play your part and experience a sense of fulfilment that will inspire you to even greater heights.

The pay range for this position is between $115,000 - $160,000 annually. However, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. An annual bonus plan may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical and/or other benefits, depending on the position offered. added.description:
Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025).

The Role

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to lead the creation of AI experiences within APCM (Advanced Primary Care Management) - our newest product line that makes healthcare feel effortless for patients. You will define and ship AI-driven workflows that automate and simplify core patient needs like appointment scheduling, medication refills, navigation, and logistics. You'll own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for a highly visible and ambitious product surface that improves the lives for over a million patients by 2030.

What You'll Do

Own the end-to-end product strategy and execution for multiple AI-centered features within APCM, from vision through launch and iteration
Reimagine and rearchitect traditional healthcare for the modern era with agent-powered patient workflows that advance primary care efficacy, engagement, and efficiency
Partner closely with engineering, design, care delivery operations, clinical leadership, and patient success teams to deliver clinically appropriate, high-quality patient experiences
Use AI and agentic tooling extensively in both product development and day-to-day execution, while shaping the right balance between automation and human oversight
Drive product discovery in an ambiguous, rapidly evolving problem space by identifying patient pain points, defining workflows, and prioritizing high-impact opportunities
Measure and optimize product outcomes through experimentation, analytics, and operational metrics tied to patient engagement, automation, and care team efficiency

What You Need

4+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex consumer product experiences
Strong product instincts and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear product direction and scalable workflows
Deep interest in AI, LLMs, and agentic systems, with excitement for building AI-native user experiences
Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, design, operations, and regulated stakeholders
Comfort operating independently in a fast-moving environment with high ownership and limited structure

Compensation

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The base salary for this role typically ranges between $200,000 - $240,000, depending on experience, skills, seniority, and business needs. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for equity as part of the total compensation package. Actual compensation may vary by location.

Benefits & Perks

Competitive pay & equity*
Fully remote
Comprehensive health coverage: Medical, dental & vision
Paid time off
401k plan + matching
Paid parental leave
Home office stipend

added.title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Device Security
added.description:
1Password is growing.
We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As Senior Staff Product Manager, Device Security, you’ll define the strategy and roadmap for the device security capabilities that help organizations understand, control, and govern access across their environments. You’ll work at the intersection of device health, identity, access management, and Artificial Intelligence (AI), helping customers reduce security risk while building a more unified experience across people, machines, and AI agents.

You’ll partner with Engineering, Design, and Go To Market (GTM) teams to turn complex security challenges into products that are clear, useful, and measurable. Reporting to the Director, Product Management – Device Security, this is a remote role open to candidates in the United States or Canada.

How We’re Using AI Today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

Required Qualifications

What we're looking for:

8+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of security, Identity and Access Management (IAM), endpoint, or access-control products.
A track record of defining and delivering roadmaps for complex, cross-functional initiatives in a Business-to-Business (B2B) Software as a Service (SaaS) environment.
Experience contributing to product vision and strategy across multiple engineering teams or product areas.
Strong written communication skills, with experience creating PRDs, PR/FAQs, and other artifacts that align teams and support decision-making.
Experience defining Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), success metrics, and measurement frameworks connected to business outcomes.
The ability to communicate complex security and product concepts clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior customer stakeholders.
A customer-centered approach to prioritization that combines qualitative insight with quantitative data.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with endpoint security, device management, zero-trust, least-privilege architectures, or related security technologies.
Familiarity with Mobile Device Management (MDM) or Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools.
Experience working with enterprise administration consoles and IT buyer or administrator personas.
Experience taking AI or machine-learning products from concept to initial launch.
Experience prototyping with AI-enabled developer tools and curiosity about how AI agents operate.
Familiarity with device compliance frameworks, endpoint telemetry platforms, or related security systems.

What You Can Expect

Own and evolve the Device Security product roadmap, partnering with engineering leadership to define priorities and deliver key capabilities.

Shape the role of Device Security within 1Password Unified Access and contribute to cross-company product strategy.
Lead weekly, monthly, and quarterly prioritization, balancing near-term delivery with an 18–24 month product vision.
Represent the customer perspective through discovery, feedback loops, recorded and live demos, and structured product artifacts such as Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) and Product Requirements/FAQs (PR/FAQs).
Collaborate with Product Managers (PMs) across adjacent product areas, as well as Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, and Product Marketing.
Establish success metrics that connect customer outcomes and Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) contribution to product progress.
Engage directly with enterprise customers, including Chief Information Security Officers (CISOs), Vice Presidents of Security, and Information Technology (IT) leaders.
Prototype proof-of-value solutions using AI-enabled developer tools to explore and communicate product ideas.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $178,000 USD and $258,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $203,000 CAD and $294,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How We Work With AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work

We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What We Offer

We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing

👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs

🩺 Competitive health benefits

🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future

📈 RSU program for most employees

💸 Retirement matching program

🔑 Free 1Password account

added.title: Principal Product Manager
added.description:
About LawnStarter

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $750M in bookings. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for home services: three brands (LawnStarter, Lawn Love, Home Gnome), one shared platform.

About Product At LawnStarter

Our BHAG: 1+ job per household, every year. Getting there means winning on four fronts at once: more customers, more Pros, excellent service experience for both sides, and an AI-run company that moves faster than its size should allow. We've organized around those bets as swim lanes: New Customer Acquisition, Strengthen Supply, Service Experience, and AI & Operating Excellence.

The Role

This is the most senior individual contributor seat in Product, with no direct reports. You'll work as a peer to the leaders of Ops, Data, Design, and Engineering.

Senior Product Managers here each own a workstream inside one of four swim lanes. You drive the Service Experience product agenda end to end: everything after a customer books, for customers and Pros, and the AI increasingly behind it. Two jobs at once: a critical thought partner to leadership on how AI reshapes our service experience, and an operator who ships with peers in engineering, design, data, marketing, and ops at a speed and quality that most would not believe. You're accountable for company-level numbers, not initiative-level ones.

What Makes This Role Different

Thought partner, not order-taker. Leadership wants your view on where AI takes the service experience, and expects you to change their minds sometimes
Speed and quality together. Small team, peers in engineering, design, data, marketing, and ops who move fast, and few layers between your judgment and what ships
Ultra AI-forward is the point. We want someone already operating the way most PMs will operate in five years
Strategy and hands. You still prototype with LLMs, write eval sets, read transcripts, and re-architect live systems yourself

Requirements

What You'll Own

The Service Experience swim lane's product strategy and roadmap: marketplace trust after booking, including setting the right expectations on both sides, steering Pros toward great work, and the increasingly AI-assisted policies that arbitrate conflicts
AI-powered support for customers and Pros, including the eval systems that gate every change (golden datasets, automated judges, regression detection, human-review sampling)
Two company-level numbers: Contribution LTV (profit per customer over their lifetime) and the brand-promise metrics
The vision and proof of concept for how AI transforms the customer and Pro experience, not just support
The bar for product: standards for shipping trustworthy AI, influencing Senior PMs by showing what great looks like, and being the person leadership calls for the hardest two-sided judgment calls

Problems to Solve

Making AI support provably good, then letting it do a lot more.
AI handles roughly a third of customer support conversations today. The goal for the next year: over half of all inquiries, customer and Pro, resolved with high satisfaction. Getting there is gated on one hard, ongoing, technical thing: proving the AI resolved a case rather than just closed it. That means defining "good" for an open-ended conversation, and catching quality drift before a customer or Pro feels it. You'll build Pro-side support on that foundation: unglamorous work that makes a slick demo safe to scale.

Keeping the promise on both sides.
Most service failures aren't bad work, they're mismatched expectations: the grass grew a tier past what was booked, or the customer wants a date the Pro can't commit to. Our promise is priced as quoted, done right, and keeping it means getting expectations right before the work starts and steering Pros toward great work. These aren't bad actors: both sides are right from where they sit, and the marketplace has to make a call. You'll build the policies and the increasingly AI-assisted systems that decide fairly and consistently at scale, and make the judgment call yourself when there's no clean answer.

Making every customer more profitable.
Trust isn't a soft metric here: customers who get what they were promised stay for years, and conflicts resolved fairly cost less to serve. You'll own Contribution LTV, targeting +10% year over year. The hard part is knowing which lever moves it (retention, cost to serve, fewer make-goods) and proving the attribution, not just asserting it.

Deciding what AI does to the whole experience, not just support.
AI already runs quietly in pricing, fraud detection, and routing. The next unlock is AI that customers and Pros notice. By year one, we want a working proof of concept and a leadership-endorsed vision for how AI transforms that experience. What's first? How do you know?

What Success Looks Like (Year 1)

50%+ of support inquiries resolved by AI with high customer and Pro satisfaction, behind an eval suite blocking regressions, plus a first version of Pro-side AI support live
Contribution LTV up 10% year over year, with attribution you can defend
Brand-promise metric goals hit: priced as quoted, done right
A working proof of concept and a leadership-endorsed vision for how AI transforms the customer and Pro experience
Leadership treats you as the person who defines where the service experience goes, not just delivers it, and the team ships faster and better because you're in the room

Who You Are

A track record of extraordinary outcomes.
Not solid, exceptional: results with your fingerprints on the decision. A generically solid resume, or wins you can't explain, won't clear the bar.

Obsessed with AI, to the point of building.
You use AI daily, have built with LLMs, and reach for AI before asking a person when you need data or want to read code. You have real intuition for whether an AI experience is good, and a view on where it's headed. Unlikely to be a good fit if you treat LLM quality as a vibe check, or evals as engineering's problem.

Obsessed with the customer and the Pro.
You live in transcripts and Pro feedback to understand both sides, and hold their interests at once, with a rationale you'd defend to either, neither indecisive nor a hip-shooter. Skip this one if you think you already know what our customers and Pros need.

Ruthlessly data-driven.
You find root causes through data, and reach for the number before the opinion. What doesn't work: leading with your gut, or refusing to move until the data is perfect.

Unbelievable speed, without dropping quality.
You ship scrappy, compress timelines, and it still makes you proud. You dive into unglamorous details like labeling eval sets and rewriting policy, because that's what quality costs. This won't work if perfectionism keeps you from shipping, or your speed leaves a mess behind.

A thought partner who multiplies the room.
You change leadership's mind, raise the bar for PMs by doing the work, and influence peers who don't report to you. Unlikely to be a good fit if you wait for direction, or guard what you know.

This Role Is NOT

A people-management role. You're an individual contributor with no direct reports. Influence comes from judgment and output, not a team you manage
A support PM role. Support is one surface of a broader area covering trust and AI, not a ticket queue or a help center
The internal-AI tooling role. A separate effort drives AI adoption in internal tooling. This role is about AI in the experience customers and Pros have
A strategy-only seat. You'll write evals, read transcripts, and prototype with LLMs. If you'd rather just set direction, this will frustrate you
A tactical delivery role. This one owns where the service experience goes, not the next feature in it. If you're strongest turning someone else's strategy into tickets, this isn't the fit

Benefits

Base salary: $185,000 to $230,000
Equity: We want our product managers to benefit from significant company growth, so equity is a meaningful part of how we structure PM compensation
Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision
Fully remote (US): Deep thinking time and partnership with peers in engineering, design, data, marketing, and ops matter more than a desk
Flexible PTO: We focus on results. Take what you need

LawnStarter provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. We comply with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment.

added.title: Principal Product Manager
added.description:
ORIGIN

Origin is building the AI-native wealth management platform that democratizes sophisticated financial services — combining money management, personalized AI-grounded advice, and financial products in a single intelligent system. We're a Series B company founded by repeat entrepreneurs, backed by Founders Fund, Felicis, and General Catalyst.

We've reached profitability and are expanding from our core personal-finance product into banking, high-yield savings, and mortgage & insurance referrals — while growing 100%+ year over year.

The Role

You'll own AI-driven product surfaces inside one of the most design-obsessed consumer finance products in the market. You will report to the CTO, partner daily with the CEO, and ship hands-on against the two things Origin is maniacal about: speed

and design

.

What you'll own

End-to-end product surface for a major area of the Origin Financial app (AI assistant, planning, investing, or onboarding — scoped on day one with the CTO).
The full PM craft, hands-on. You write the PRDs, run the discovery, push the Figma files with our design partner, define the test plan, draft the QA cases, sit in on engineering standups, and own the metric.
AI-native execution. You're expected to use AI heavily — for research, competitive teardowns, prototypes, PRD drafts, deck building, test-plan generation, exec readouts. Tooling preference is yours; the bar is the output and the speed.
The interface between engineering, design, marketing, and Origin Financial's leadership team. You make the cross-functional motion run.
Metric ownership. Every ship declares its activation / retention / ARPU / NPS target before the build starts, and you own the readout after.

How you work

Low ego. You thoughtful, an amazing listener and want to deeply understand problems before acting. You happily share credit and split scope with peers. You'd rather be right tomorrow than loud today.
Hands-on, every day. No throwing work over the wall. You produce the artifacts yourself.
You move fast. A week feels long. You ship the smallest thing that proves the bet.
Design taste is non-negotiable. You don't have to push pixels, but you must be able to look at two flows and pick the better one — and say why.
You write. Specs, decision memos, post-mortems. Writing is the artifact at Origin.

What you've done

6+ years in product management with shipping reps in both a larger company (mature surface, real scale, real cross-functional rigor) and a small / early-stage company (0→1, no scaffolding, owned a P&L).
Strong written communicator. Your PRDs, decision docs, and exec updates are short, testable, and unambiguous.
Either one of the two paths:

3+ years in financial services — consumer fintech, wealth, neobank, brokerage, lending, or insurance. You understand RIA / BD / custody / regulated-flow constraints well enough to ship without breaking them.
3+ years in highly competitive direct-to-consumer SaaS — consumer product, growth and distribution, rapid iteration and research. You understand the metrics and the pace that is required in a competitive marketplace.

AI-product experience (Nice to have) — you've shipped an AI feature (LLM-backed, agentic, or assistive) inside a consumer or financial product, with real metrics.
Quantitative fluency (Nice to have) — You pull your own data if needed. You read a retention curve and a funnel without a deck. You partner with the data leadership for complex modelling, but don’t sit idle.

This is not the role if

You expect a "hand-off executive" seat where you delegate the craft. At Origin you own both the vision and execution.
You believe AI-leveraged PM work is beneath you. Origin is an AI-heavy org — if you wouldn't draft your own PRD with AI, this isn't your role.

Reporting & location

Reports to the CTO. Weekly 1:1 with the CTO; bi-weekly 1:1 with the CEO. Direct exposure to the founders is structural, not optional.
Monthly Boston on-site. 2–3 days at our Boston HQ during one designated week; travel covered. No Boston residency required.

What we offer for this role

Principal PM band, calibrated for Tier-1 metropolitan areas.
Meaningful equity grant package.
Travel covered for in-office weeks.
Healthcare.
Wellness stipend.
Mental wellness program.
Unlimited access to financial planning.
Life insurance.
Retirement 401k.
Unlimited DPTO.
Paid Parental Leave.
Parenthood and fertility assistance.
Monthly co-working membership reimbursement.
Build your home office one-time stipend.
Pick your setup (Apple, Windows) and accessories.

Eligibility Requirements

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
Origin does not sponsor visas.

ORIGINALS

Fulfilling our mission is only possible with a diverse team that breathes for excellence and is hugely committed to making money simple for everyone, everywhere.

As a team, we are obsessed with delivering the best solution possible to our members through an elegant and self-guided experience. We know that building a product of this magnitude requires from us tons of creativity, autonomy, and flexibility to move fast and embrace uncertainties with ownership. This is who

we daily pursue to be!

To embrace talented people like this and provide the necessary resources to achieve their best versions, we believe in the power of a healthy environment where each person is valued for who they are and have clear goals and expectations for the future they can build within the company. Each person here is seen as a key player in our team.

Our environment is diverse, with excellent people and equal opportunities. We believe in the power of the individuality and uniqueness of each of us to make our team even more powerful.

We are building an outstanding solution, and here is an invitation for you to become an Original and join us on this journey!

added.description:
Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is creating the best rent payment experience. It’s hard to believe that it’s 2026 and paying rent on time is expensive, inflexible, and difficult. We’re here to change that! Flex enables our users to pay rent throughout the month on a schedule that better fits their finances and budget. Our mission is to empower as many renters as possible with flexibility over their most significant recurring expense. After deliberately keeping a stealth profile as we built up unprecedented investor support and an enthusiastic user base, we are looking for motivated individuals to help us keep our mission growing. Will you be a part of the team?

About The Role

We're hiring a Principal Product Manager, Payments
to lead one of the most critical areas of our infrastructure: how money flows in and out of Flex. You will oversee our end-to-end payments platform - including transaction processing, payment-related fraud and disputes - and ensure it evolves into a strategic growth and margin lever.

This role is ideal for someone who thinks in platforms and systems, understands payment mechanics, and knows how to balance user experience, risk, and cost. You’ll work closely with Platform and Risk leadership to drive innovation and performance across payment rails, dispute automation, and fraud prevention, while enabling seamless user experiences and future expansion.

What You’ll Do

Shape the cross-functional platform product strategy. Map how future products fit together into a coherent architecture, and help ensure they’re built with speed and stability in mind.
Own Flex’s payments platform strategy and roadmap end-to-end: vaulting, authorization, processing, reconciliation, and refunds across all payment methods (card, wallet, ACH).
Drive down payment processing costs through better routing, smarter retry logic, and fraud/dispute efficiency - without sacrificing UX or resilience.
Build and scale fraud detection and dispute infrastructure to reduce losses while minimizing false positives and user friction.
Expand our payment method coverage, ensuring all channels (cards, bank transfers, wallets) are supported with the right controls, guardrails, and visibility.
Partner with Risk, Finance, Ops, and Engineering to align on business goals and build resilient, compliant, and scalable payment solutions.
Lead and grow a high-performing product team, coaching PMs while maintaining a strong bar for ownership and quality.
Define success metrics and build dashboards, tooling, and processes to measure performance across cost, reliability, speed, and loss rates.
Champion clear thinking, technical depth, and rigorous prioritization in a fast-moving, high-volume environment.

Key Qualifications

7+ years of product experience, with at least 3+ years in payments, fraud, or platform product roles at a fintech, bank, or B2B2C fintech products.
Deep understanding of the payments ecosystem: authorization, retries, tokenization, payment gateways, fraud systems, and card networks.
Demonstrated ability to balance user experience, cost optimization, fraud risk, and regulatory requirements in product decisions.
Strong technical acumen and systems thinking - you’ve worked closely with engineers to design reliable, scalable systems.
Proven success as a player-coach: you’ve managed PMs and enjoy mentoring while rolling up your sleeves when needed.
Bonus: Experience working with Payment processors, building dispute automation, or expanding payment options in regulated environments.

Compensation

Flex takes a market-based approach to pay, ensuring compensation is commensurate with a candidate's experience and our internal leveling guidelines. For candidates located in our Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area) markets, the base salary pay range for this role is below. Flex utilizes a geographic pay differential based on a cost of labor index. If you are located outside of the cities listed below, your starting pay will be adjusted to align with the market conditions of your specific geographic zone. Please speak with your recruiter for additional information regarding the specific range for your location.

Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area)

$248,000—$310,000 USD

Life at Flex

We understand that it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self aware people to grow a successful company. Our HQ is located in New York City, but we have employees located throughout the US, Australia, Canada and South America. We are growing quickly, but deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity workplace.

Offices

Roles posted in New York, San Francisco, and Salt Lake City are hybrid positions with on-site expectations of 2-3 days per week in our local offices. For candidates outside of these areas, you may be eligible for our relocation assistance program.

Benefits

For full-time U.S. employees we offer:

Competitive medical, dental, and vision
Company equity
401(k) plan with company match
Unlimited paid time off + 13 company paid holidays
Parental leave
Free Flex subscription

For full-time non-U.S. employees, we offer:

Competitive compensation + company equity
Unlimited PTO

Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About The Role

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and optimization of Dandy’s practice-facing software as we expand internationally. In this role, you will own key software tools and workflows that empower dental practices to run their operations smoothly—including how they manage their account and interact with Dandy’s core services.

You will partner with engineering, design, finance, operations, sales, and customer service to build intuitive, scalable, and compliant software that delights practice owners and their teams. This is a high-impact role where you will balance exceptional user experience with operational excellence to support both our customers' success and Dandy’s business expansion globally.

What You’ll Do

Own the Practice Software Vision & Roadmap – Define and execute a multi-year strategy for Dandy’s practice-facing tools, ensuring reliability, scalability, and seamless user experiences across daily operations.
Deliver Seamless Practice Experiences – Build intuitive, transparent, and user-friendly software that simplifies complex tasks, earns customer trust, and reduces friction for practice staff.
Collaborate Across Functions – Partner with engineering, product design, finance, legal, sales, and customer operations to align on product priorities, requirements, and execution.
Ensure Accuracy & Compliance – Work with finance and legal to ensure financial and practice-facing systems meet tax, healthcare, regulatory, and audit standards across geographies.
Optimize for Growth – Support flexible practice workflows, new revenue models, flexible payment options, and feature expansions into new markets.
Modernize Our Infrastructure – Evaluate and implement integrations with payment processors, practice management systems (PMS), tax engines, and external service providers.
Leverage Data to Improve Systems – Track user engagement, product performance, and financial metrics to identify trends, eliminate friction, and drive strong business and customer outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

4+ years of product management experience, ideally building B2B SaaS or practice-facing software.
Technical fluency—you can work closely with engineering on system architecture, APIs, data flows, and third-party integrations.
Customer obsession—you deeply understand the daily lives of practice owners and office staff, advocate for their success, and design products that make their work easier.
Cross-functional leadership—proven ability to manage complex stakeholder needs across business, technical, and operational teams.
Strong analytical skills, with comfort working with performance metrics and operational data to diagnose problems and drive product decisions.
High bias for action—you move quickly, navigate ambiguity, remove blockers, and deliver measurable value.
Excellent communication skills, with a talent for translating complex user needs and technical requirements into clear, actionable product specs.

About Pinterest

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Intro

We’re looking for a highly adaptable Principal Product Designer, AI Native to join our Core design team. You’ll support projects and teams across the suite of Pinterest business products, ramping up quickly where help is needed most. You’ll collaborate with teammates in a dynamic environment, regularly tackling new design challenges.

What You’ll Do

Establish the strategic direction and product vision for our most complex problems, including the future of integrating AI based assistive tools into our consumer product, while bridging the gap between vision and execution
Be at the forefront of major design initiatives and broadcast the efforts of the design team across Pinterest
Set and refine the design quality bar, in partnership with design leadership, through our principles and design system
Be responsible for mentoring and helping grow talent within the team

What We’re Looking For

12+ years with a track record of shipping inspiring well built experiences leveraging the latest technology
Experience with LLMs, prompt shaping/engineering, prototyping, and working on AI product flows and with agentic systems
A respected designer and product thinker that has mastered their craft and cohesive product strategy, ideally a renaissance person with endless curiosity
A mentor who is energized by growing others’ careers and knows how to motivate a team
An inspiring communicator that represents creative work, builds trust and influences alignment of our creative vision across marketing, PR and product
A portfolio demonstrating breadth and creativity and proven experience in product design, design thinking and product strategy
Bachelor’s degree in design, a related field or equivalent experience

Relocation Statement:

This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement

We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.
This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times every 6-months, and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. added.title: Senior Product Manager
added.description:
Link Logistics Real Estate (“Link”) is a leading operator of warehouses and business parks, specializing in last-mile logistics real estate. Established by Blackstone in 2019, the company connects consumption, technology, and the supply chain across its portfolio, which spans half a billion square feet. We leverage our scale, proprietary data and insights, and foundational focus on sustainability to drive success for our customers’ businesses and deliver value for our stakeholders. We put our people, customers, and communities first and find ways to make a conscious, positive impact where we live and work. Every day, we work to reinvent and lead our industry forward by thinking bigger and challenging the status quo.

As the Senior Product Manager
for our Integrated Services team, you will play a pivotal role in defining and executing our technology strategy and roadmap for our business partners responsible for centralized services that manage and maintain our properties. Reporting to the Director of Product, you will be responsible for building and maintaining strong partnerships between the Technology department and business stakeholders. This role requires a strategic thinker with excellent communication skills, a deep understanding of business processes, and the ability to translate business needs into IT solutions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Product Management

Manage the product strategy and roadmap, in partnership with business partners and vendors.
Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of business partners’ processes and operational needs.
Engage with business partners and other stakeholders to create and manage a demand management process to analyze, prioritize, and deliver on project and enhancement requests.
Define and manage OKRs and KPIs that build confidence in the platform and ensure the platform meets the needs and goals of the business.
Engage user communities in a continuous feedback loop that drives the platform forward.

Stakeholder Management

Develop and nurture relationships with key business stakeholders to understand their objectives, challenges, and strategic priorities.
Act as a trusted advisor, providing insights and recommendations on how technology can support and enhance business goals.
Communicate and collaborate across many levels in the organization with excellent and written communication skills.
Translate innovative ideas into functional and technical requirements to helping our teams work smarter.
Guide, influence, and persuade business partners and team members towards solutions that meet business needs and goals.
Maintain relationships with external partners and vendors that challenge them to deliver world-class service for Link.

Project Delivery

Develop business cases, user requirements, and project charters.
Manage processes to prioritize projects, plan releases, and manage resources.
Create and manage processes for testing, release management, and change control.
Manage communications with business partners, project team, and IT management.

Technology Operations

Define and manage data integrations with internal and external products and platforms.
Develop and manage metrics that ensure vendors and external partners meet or exceed operational expectations.
Collaborate with Internal Audit to ensure that IT General Controls are defined as needed for projects and applications and then followed as routine operations.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum of 10 years technology experience
Knowledge of Salesforce, Yardi, or similar applications a plus.
5 years managing customer success, technology operations, or SaaS platform delivery
Expertise in technology product management
Experience defining and managing product roadmaps
Relationship management and customer engagement skills
Technology project management experience
Ability to concisely articulate problems and analyze solution alternatives
Outstanding communication skills
Knowledge of real estate industry and CRE technology a major plus

$165,000 - $180,000 represents the presently anticipated base compensation pay range for this position at Link. Actual pay may vary based on various factors, including but not limited to location and experience.

Link provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, retirement savings plan, paid holidays, paid time off.

added.title: Senior Product Manager - Core Interfaces
added.description:
Mercury is built for the building class: those who act on their ambition, who see something that doesn't exist and decide to make it real with their time, money, and team; whether that's a side project or a scaling unicorn. We build the financial stack for them, backed by elegant and intelligent software meant to work from day one to scale.

Dashboard is the home base of Mercury and the connective tissue between everything you need: home, search, tasks, notifications, and the moment-to-moment sense of place and priority. When it's done right, it feels like a thousand tiny things working invisibly in your favor.

As Mercury grows more capable, it also grows more complex. Our job is to make sure customers only ever feel the first part: to take an increasingly powerful product and keep it legible, no matter how much is happening underneath it.

Our product should meet customers where they are: every task closed, every intent read correctly, every alert landing before it's needed. We aim to make our customers feel that their ambition is inevitable.

Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

What you’ll do:

Take ownership of an underdefined, high-stakes surface and develop a real point of view on what it should be; starting with Tasks, Home, and Notifications
Lead a redesign of the Mercury home page: what belongs on it, what doesn't, and how it earns its real estate as the product's job for the customer changes
Design the unified logic behind tasks, lifecycle updates, and in-product alerts
Partner closely with Command, agents, and product teams that will increasingly lean on these surfaces to drive intent
Set direction and a prioritized roadmap, balancing user needs against the needs of every product team that depends on Dashboard as connective tissue
Work as a true collaborator with design, shaping the visual and interaction language of core surfaces
Operate independently in ambiguity, contributing to the visioning, sequencing, and execution of a multi-phase overhaul of horizontal Dashboard experiences
Regularly present strategy and tradeoffs to company leadership
Translate qualitative and quantitative data into insights that inform the team's work

What we need from you:

7+ years of relevant product management experience, preferably on horizontal product or platform teams accountable for a quality user experience. Bonus points for cohesive dashboard experience in fintech
Deep design taste. You believe how something looks and feels is part of what it does
A track record of turning ambiguity into a clear point of view, independently
Real fluency working with designers as a peer, you're energized by working alongside partners and stakeholders who are obsessed with the details
The ability to take complex problems end to end (research, design, engineering, GTM, stakeholder management) autonomously
